title: Pareto Frontier Prioritization: Latency-Cost Elasticity & OKR Alignment
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Proposal to pilot a Pareto-frontier driven prioritization framework that augments RICE with latency-cost elasticity curves and explicit OKR alignment weights. The goal is to prioritize roadmap items that sit on the optimal tradeoff frontier for production economics (per-token cost, p95 latency) while respecting objective impact to OKRs (revenue, reliability, developer adoption). This ticket scopes the pilot, defines the scoring formula, and validates with two representative initiatives: low-latency kernel optimizations and batching/caching improvements for cold-start workloads.
problem_statement: Current prioritization signals (standard RICE and cost estimates) surface high-impact ideas but fail to surface those that are Pareto-optimal for combined latency and cost, nor do they easily encode OKR tradeoffs. Teams end up choosing high-reach features with poor unit economics or low-cost optimizations that don't move top-level OKRs.
proposal_summary: Introduce a composite score: PF-Score = ParetoWeight * ParetoRank + RICE_norm + OKR_weighted_impact. ParetoRank is derived from a simulated points set of estimated cost reduction vs latency impact (both measured as elasticities). The approach (1) models per-initiative elasticity curves, (2) simulates expected operating points across typical traffic mixes, (3) computes which initiatives lie on the Pareto frontier, and (4) combines frontier position with normalized RICE and OKR alignment to rank backlog items.
acceptance_criteria: Definition and doc for PF-Score formula published in Confluence
Pilot dataset (10 initiatives) instrumented with cost and latency elasticities and simulated traffic mixes
Scoring run produces ranked list and clear Pareto frontier visualization in the Console dashboard
Two pilot initiatives selected for Q1 rollout and tracked through OKR metrics
Post-pilot retrospective with buy/no-buy decision and framework adjustments
decisions: Use elasticity (percent delta in cost per percent change in latency) as the canonical tradeoff metric
Normalize RICE components to 0-1 and use OKR impact as a 0-1 multiplier to favoritism for strategic bets
Visualize Pareto frontier with interactive toggles for traffic mix (latency-sensitive vs throughput-sensitive)

review_feedback: Lina (Eng): Recommend adding confidence intervals to elasticity estimates — these materially affect frontier membership.
Sam (Console PM): Dashboard needs a mode exposing token-level cost breakdown when you click an initiative on the frontier.
Priya (Research): Include model-variant sensitivity — smaller/quantized variants change curves and should be treated as distinct initiatives or sub-variants.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Elasticity estimates are noisy and may misclassify initiatives. Mitigation: require two independent measurement methods (bench + small-scale prod canary) and expose CI.
Risk: Overweighting Pareto leads to neglected high-reach features. Mitigation: OKR weighting and explicit stakeholder veto in scoring pipeline.
Risk: Complexity reduces adoption. Mitigation: provide a one-click RICE-equivalent simplified score and tutorial examples.

notes_for_reviewers: Focus review on (1) defensibility of elasticity measurement, (2) appropriateness of OKR weighting scheme, and (3) dashboard clarity for non-technical execs. Please add comments in the Confluence doc or the spreadsheet.
outcome_criteria_for_pilot: If pilot initiatives achieve >=10% unit-cost improvement with <=5% p95 latency regression (weighted by traffic mix) and move OKR metrics positively, recommend wider adoption and include PF-Score in quarterly roadmap gating.
